verses.text: ነቢዩ ዕንባቆም ያየው ሸክም ይህ ነው።
አቤቱ፥ እኔ ስጮኽ የማትሰማው እስከ መቼ ነው? ስለ ግፍ ወደ አንተ እጮኻለሁ፥ አንተም አታድንም።
በደልንስ ስለ ምን አሳየኸኝ? ጠማምነትንስ ስለ ምን ትመለከታለህ? ጥፋትና ግፍ በፊቴ ነው፣ ጠብና ክርክር ይነሣሉ።
ስለዚህ ሕግ ላልቶአል፥ ፍርድም ድል ነሥቶ አይወጣም፣ ኃጢአተኛ ጻድቅን ይከብባልና፣ ስለዚህ ፍርድ ጠማማ ሆኖ ይወጣል።
እናንተ የምትንቁ ሆይ፥ አንድ ቢተርክላችሁ ስንኳ የማታምኑትን ሥራ በዘመናችሁ እሠራለሁና እዩ፥ ተመልከቱ፥ ተደነቁ።
እነሆ፥ የእነርሱ ያልሆነውን መኖሪያ ይወርሱ ዘንድ በምድር ስፋት ላይ የሚሄዱትን መራሮችንና ፈጣኖችን ሕዝብ ከለዳውያንን አስነሣለሁ።
እነርሱ የሚያስፈሩና የሚያስደነግጡ ናቸው፣ ፍርዳቸውና ክብራቸው ከራሳቸው ይወጣል።
ፈረሶቻቸውም ከነብር ይልቅ ፈጣኖች ናቸው፥ ከማታም ተኵላ ይልቅ ጨካኞች ናቸው፣ ፈረሰኞቻቸውም ይንሳፈፋሉ፥ ከሩቅም ይመጣሉ፥ ለመብልም እንደሚቸኵል ንስር ይበርራሉ።
ሁሉም ለግፍ ሥራ ይመጣሉ፥ ፊታቸውንም እንደ ምሥራቅ ነፋስ ያቀናሉ፣ ምርኮኞችንም እንደ አሸዋ ይሰበስባሉ።
በነገሥታት ላይ ያላግጣሉ፥ መሳፍንትም ዋዛ ሆነውላቸዋል፣ በምሽጉ ሁሉ ይስቃሉ፥ አፈሩንም ከምረው ይወስዱታል።
In that time, it shall pass like the wind; it shall be swept away, and God shall perform His might.
O Lord, my holy God, hast Thou not been from everlasting? We shall not die; O Lord, Thou hast appointed for judgment, and for retribution hast Thou made provision.

Thy eyes are pure, that they may not behold evil; and concerning iniquity, Thou canst not look; why then dost Thou look upon those who deal treacherously? And why dost Thou remain silent when the wicked devours the righteous?
Why dost Thou treat men like fish of the sea, like creeping things that have no ruler over them?
He shall take all away with a hook; He shall gather them in His net; He shall catch them in His dragnet; therefore, He rejoices and is glad.
The chance of their fortune is in their own hands, and their food is abundant; therefore, they shall be filled with the net, and they shall be strengthened in the dragnet.
Therefore, shall they empty the net? And shall they continually slay nations without pity?
I will stand upon my watch, and set me upon the tower, and will watch to see what he will say unto me, and what I shall answer when I am reproved.
And the Lord answered me and said, Write the vision, and make it plain upon tables, that he may run that readeth it.
For the vision is yet for an appointed time, but at the end it shall speak, and not lie: though it tarry, wait for it; because it will surely come, it will not tarry.
Behold, his soul which is lifted up is not upright in him: but the just shall live by his faith.

Yea, also, because he transgresseth by wine, he is a proud man, neither keepeth at home, who enlargeth his desire as hell, and is as death, and cannot be satisfied, but gathereth unto him all nations, and heapeth unto him all people.

Shall not all these take up a parable against him, and a taunting proverb against him, and say, Woe to him that increaseth that which is not his! how long? and to him that ladeth himself with thick clay!
Shall they not rise up suddenly that shall bite thee, and awake that shall vex thee, and thou shalt be for booties unto them?
Because thou hast shed man's blood, by violence, and hast committed iniquity against the land, against the city, and against all that dwell therein, surely the blood of many shall be upon thee.
Woe to him that buildeth a town with blood, and stablisheth a city by iniquity!
Behold, is it not of the Lord of hosts that the people shall labor in the very fire, and the people shall weary themselves for very vanity?
The stone cries out from within the wall, and the wood answers from the framework.
Woe to the city that is built by blood, and woe to the city that is established by iniquity!
Behold, is it not the case that nations are made to burn with fire, and peoples to toil in vanity, by the hand of the Lord of hosts, who is God?
The earth is filled with the knowledge of the glory of the Lord, as the waters cover the sea.
Woe to him who drinks from his neighbor's cup to see the nakedness of the flesh, and who adds to the wickedness, and who causes others to stumble!
In glory, mercy has filled you; you also, being humble, walk humbly, for the Lord's right hand shall return to you, and mercy shall be upon your honor.

Because you have shed the blood of man, and because of the violence done in the land and in the city, and to all who dwell therein, because of the violence you have wrought in Lebanon, may the violence you have committed terrify you, and the destruction of beasts shall cause you to tremble.

What use is the image that is carved, and what profit is it to the maker of the image that has been carved? For idols are made to be worshipped, yet the maker of the lie teaches falsehood; what good is a deceitful image that has been made?
The wood cries out: "Awake!" and the stone answers: "Arise!" Woe to him who says this! Is it not true that this teaches us? Behold, it is adorned with gold and silver, yet it has no breath at all.
But the Lord is in His holy temple; let all the earth keep silence before Him.
The prayer of the prophet concerning the lamentation.
O Lord, I have heard Thy report and I was afraid;
O God, from Teman,
Thy brightness is as the light;
He shall come forth from His presence;
Stand, and let the earth be still;
I saw the dwellings of Ethiopia in distress;
Truly, has God been troubled over the rivers?
By Thy word as it is written;
The mountains trembled at Thy sight.
Your light arose from the place of their departure,
Upon the earth, You have made me to soar like an eagle,
To protect Your people,
The head of the rulers You have crushed with Your own strength,
Your horses in the sea,
I have heard, and my heart rejoiced within me,
Though I may not fear the name,
Yet I find joy in the Lord God,
The Lord God is my strength.
